acceptanceCriteria: Warm additional-repository corpus MCP calls avoid repeating checkout observation and pin verification when the observed checkout is unchanged, without weakening drift detection.
A measured before/after on the 8,001-input fixture is retained, warm p95 below the pre-change 218 ms.
body: Residual of V1-2328 (GH #1487) lane PR beamfall/corvint#1504. After the freshness-overlay reuse, warm freshness is 32-87 ms (median ~40, p95 218 ms) on 8,001 inputs; the remaining per-call cost is checkout observation (35-45 ms) and pin verification (~70 ms).
title: Corpus MCP additional-repository warm calls still pay 35-45 ms checkout observation plus ~70 ms pin verification per call
